title: Diamond
summary: Use one diamond in the Devil’s Fee ritual to open the House of Hope portal. A Black or Infernal Diamond can substitute.

fields.Use: Use one diamond in the Devil’s Fee ritual to open the House of Hope portal. A Black or Infernal Diamond can substitute.
fields.Base value: 220 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
